_meta._note: Gemini 4 Hydrogen launch (blog, model card, evals methodology, AA, Vals) plus OpenRouter pages (prices, Vals/Design Arena panels). Fill-only; conflicts in s320/report.json.

models.name: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
models._note: Launch blog 'Nov 12, 2026' (Koray Kavukcuoglu). Adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon (model card). Four thinking levels low/medium/high (default)/xhigh; base id = xhigh (AA base slug 'Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Xhigh)', Google card run at highest thinking, Vals reasoning effort xhigh). 1M context, up to 64K sync output / 1M via background long decode. $1.50/$7.50 per M flat across the 1M window; knowledge cutoff March 2026.

models.name: Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High)
models._note: Default "high" thinking level of Gemini 4 Hydrogen (AA slug gemini-4-hydrogen-high).

models.name: Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low)
models._note: Low thinking level of Gemini 4 Hydrogen (AA slug gemini-4-hydrogen-low).

models.name: Gemini Decision 1
models._note: Google's model for the Decisions API (OpenRouter description): answers structured questions about an input state (true/false, multiple choice up to 255 options, score up to 255 levels) with a confidence per answer. OpenRouter listing 2026-11-11 (permaslug gemini-decision-1-20261111); no Google launch date read, so release_date left empty.

models.name: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
models._note: Native multimodal video generation/editing model, successor to Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash: clips up to 15 s with native audio, 16:9 or 9:16, 360p drafts to 4K (OpenRouter). Date = OpenRouter created_at and permaslug gemini-omni-1.2-flash-20261105.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 4.1 (cheating-adjusted)
benchmarks.description: Terminal-Bench 4.1 agentic terminal tasks scored with cheating-adjusted accuracy (runs that game the verifier count as failures), as reported in the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model card.

benchmarks.name: MKA (Multimodal Knowledge Agent) — Climb WSR accuracy
benchmarks.description: Multimodal Knowledge Agent benchmark: end-to-end agentic knowledge work over complex visual files (PDFs, spreadsheets, charts, audio, video); Climb WSR accuracy. Artificial Analysis runs it (RSC field mkaClimbWsr, previously unidentified in S317); Google self-computes Gemini 4 Hydrogen.
